title: Memory Leak Investigation reference solution
explanation: A leak is about objects remaining reachable when they should not be, not simply memory usage increasing once. Compare heap evidence over time with JFR/heap dumps and inspect retaining paths; do not rely on `System.gc()` to prove reclamation.
